items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: It was a small group with Pinky, Vidalgovich, of course. And it was, as I recall, some of the boys from the Owl Band, because Bill Padron, I think, was on trumpet, and Bert Peck played the piano.

ctx.x: I have heard of them. I think it was Pinky.

It was a small group with Pinky, Vidalgovich, of course. And it was, as I recall, some of the boys from the Owl Band, because Bill Padron, I think, was on trumpet, and Bert Peck played the piano. I don't recall the rest of them. It was a very fine little band, never recorded, but just played for dances around town.
I think that's a band that combined with the Owls or something.
